name: AUSNUT 2023 selected foods
basis: Per 100 g edible portion in the named preparation state. Energy includes dietary fibre; available carbohydrate excludes sugar alcohols.
transformations: Ten supported single-food entries selected by public food key.
Energy converted from kJ to kcal by dividing by 4.184.
Allergen and dietary tags are application annotations, not FSANZ nutrient measurements. Oats are conservatively excluded for gluten restrictions.
limitations: Not an exhaustive allergen database; product labels and cross-contact information must be checked.
Amounts describe edible portions; cooked and uncooked weights are not interchangeable.
